label: Cellular Automaton
description: Cellular automaton — evolve a grid N generations under a Birth/Survive rule (Conway's Game of Life B3/S23, HighLife, Maze, Cave, or custom). Seed from the input mask or a random fill. Moore/von-Neumann neighbours, wrap/dead/mirror edges. Emits the 0/1 state → Morphology / Marching Squares / Graph to Spaces.
